description.zh: 月视图加自己的条目——点一天，写一行，或者粘一份 .ics 进来
description.en: Month view with your own events — click a day, type a line, or paste an .ics

help.zh: 哪一天排在第一列。世界上多数地方用周一，美国用周日。
help.en: Which day sits in the first column. Monday for most of the world, Sunday for the US.

items.zh: 点一天，在下面的输入框里写一行，回车就记上了。记在哪一天，取决于你点的是哪一天。
items.en: Click a day, then type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. The day you clicked is the day it lands on.

items.zh: 行首写时间就会留下：「9:30 站会」存成 09:30 加标题「站会」。不写时间的算全天，排在有时刻的条目上面。
items.en: Start the line with a time and it is kept: `9:30 Standup` is stored as 09:30 plus the title `Standup`. Without a time it is an all-day entry and sorts above the timed ones.

items.zh: 点某一行上的 ✕ 就删掉。没有撤销——但删除只要一下，重写也只要一行。
items.en: Click the ✕ on a row to delete it. There is no undo — but deleting is one click, and typing it again is one line.

items.zh: 数字下面的小圆点表示那天有安排。一个月固定画六周，翻月时格子高度不会跳。
items.en: A dot under a number means that day has something on it. The month always shows six weeks, so the grid does not jump in height as you page through.

items.zh: 邻月的日子是灰的——点它会跳到那个月，而不是让条目看起来记错了月份。
items.en: Days from the neighbouring months are shown greyed — clicking one jumps to that month rather than making it look like the entry landed in the wrong place.

items.zh: ‹ 和 › 一次翻一个月。标题可以点，点一下回到今天。
items.en: The ‹ and › buttons move one month. The title is clickable and takes you back to today.

items.zh: 点当天那一行右边的「导入」，把 .ics 的全文粘进去。从日历应用导出、用记事本打开就能全选复制。
items.en: Click Import at the right of the day row and paste the whole .ics. Export it from your calendar app, open it in Notepad, copy all.

items.zh: 认标题、开始时间、全天事件和常见的重复规则（每天 / 每周 / 每月 / 每年，带间隔、次数、截止和星期几）。
items.en: It reads the title, the start time, all-day events and the usual repeat rules (daily / weekly / monthly / yearly, with interval, count, until and weekdays).

items.zh: 时区不换算：带 TZID 的当本地时间；带 Z 的按 UTC 换算过来。
items.en: Time zones are not converted: a TZID value is taken as local time, while a trailing Z is converted from UTC.

items.zh: 重复事件只展开一年（单个最多 120 条），被单独取消的某一次（EXDATE）不认。
items.en: Repeats are expanded for one year at most (120 entries per event), and single cancelled instances (EXDATE) are not understood.

items.zh: 同一天里时间与标题都一样的算重复，所以同一份文件导入两次不会出现两遍。
items.en: An entry with the same time and title on the same day counts as a duplicate, so importing the same file twice does not double it.

items.zh: 只存你写下的东西，按组件分开——条目放在这个组件自己的存储里，两张日历不共享同一份表。
items.en: Only what you typed, per widget — the events are kept in this widget's own storage, so two calendars do not share a list.

items.zh: 什么都不上传。没有账号、没有同步，这一版也不需要联网权限。
items.en: Nothing is uploaded anywhere. There is no account, no sync, and no network permission in this version.

items.zh: 选中的那一天也会记住，重新打开卡片就停在你离开的地方。
items.en: The selected day is remembered too, so reopening the card lands where you left off.

changes.zh: 可以从别的日历导入了：把 .ics 全文粘进「导入」，重复事件按规则展开成一条条。
changes.en: Events can now come from another calendar: paste the whole .ics into Import, and repeats are expanded into single entries.

changes.zh: 导完会报数（导入多少条、跳过多少重复），并把视图跳到第一条进来的那天。
changes.en: Afterwards it says how many came in and how many were duplicates, and jumps the view to the first imported day.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：月份写「2026年10月」，星期头写「周一」…「周日」，全天、空态和按钮也跟着换。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: a Chinese month reads 2026年10月, weekday headers read 周一…周日, and all-day entries, empty states and buttons follow.

changes.zh: 月份按钮挪开了，不再压在右上角的窗口按钮下面。
changes.en: The month buttons moved clear of the window buttons in the top-right corner.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：月视图，点一天、写一行就加一条。
changes.en: First release: month view, click a day, type a line to add an event.

changes.zh: 行首的时间（「9:30 …」）会被解析并保留，其余是标题。
changes.en: A leading time (`9:30 …`) is parsed and kept; the rest is the title.

changes.zh: 固定六周的网格，翻月时卡片高度不变。
changes.en: Six-week grid so the card does not change height between months.
